title: Japan national CPI (February 2027), 08:30 JST
source: EST: stat.go.jp/english/data/cpi/1582.html ('Consumer Price Index — Schedule of Release', page's own 'Last Update : 23 January 2026'), fetched raw direct 2026-09-05 (HTTP 200, 13,839 bytes) and parsed cell-by-cell out of its single HTML table by this session. Columns are 'Japan: Survey month | Date of release || Ku-area of Tokyo (preliminary): Survey month | Date of release || Remarks'; the row parses exactly as ['February', 'March 19', 'March', 'March 26', '2026 fiscal yearly average of Ku-area of Tokyo'] — i.e. the February-2027 national CPI releases 2027-03-19, with the Tokyo March flash following 2027-03-26. NOTE ON THAT REMARKS CELL, added by the 2027-03-19 initial research: it belongs to the 2027-03-26 TOKYO release, not to this one. The Bureau's remark attaches to whichever column it names — exact on all six remarks in the table, 'of Japan' to the national column and 'of Ku-area of Tokyo' to the Tokyo column — and the arithmetic agrees, since a fiscal-year average needs the final month of its own period in its own geography and Japan's FY2026 ends 2027-03-31. This release therefore carries NO supplementary headline (FT-japan-cpi-2027-03-19-3). Filed estimate on three counts, identical to the sibling japan-cpi-2027-01-22 entry: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has BLS:/BEA:/CENSUS: for US statistical agencies and no slot for Japan's Statistics Bureau, this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and the schedule page's own last-update stamp is 2026-01-23 — ~19 months stale at the fetch date, and this is the LAST row the published table carries. The 08:30 JST release time is the Statistics Bureau's standing convention and is NOT read off this page — treat it as the weaker half of this entry
notes: DISCOVERED during the boj-decision-2027-03-18 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05), and the reason it is tracked: this print lands ONE DAY AFTER the Bank of Japan's March 2027 MPM decision (boj-decision-2027-03-18, estimate), so the board decides without it. AMENDED BY THIS EVENT'S OWN INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-05, docs/research/events/japan-cpi-2027-03-19.md), which measured two claims this entry originally asserted and found both over-claimed. (1) 'WORST-INFORMED VENUE' IS TOO STRONG. The board holds the national January print (japan-cpi-2027-02-19, estimate, released 2027-02-19) and the Tokyo February flash (japan-cpi-tokyo-flash-2027-02-26, estimate) — both filed in the same PR. Across 27 Februaries (2000-2026, e-Stat 2025-base files parsed locally) the January national core y/y sits 0.178pp mean absolute and 0.116pp median from the February core y/y it precedes, against a Bureau that publishes to one decimal. The March MPM is the least FRESHLY informed 2027 venue on Japanese prices, and that costs roughly a fifth of a rounding step, not a blind spot. The same session also benchmarked the Tokyo flash the sibling japan-cpi-2027-01-22 ledger called a '~80% pre-published' lead indicator: against simply repeating the previous national print it wins only 114 of 319 months since 2000 (36%) and 9 of 27 Februaries (33%), with a worse mean and median — its edge exists only in the 2018+ window, at 52%. Registered as FT-japan-cpi-2027-03-19-1. (2) 'THE SAME SESSION' AS US TRIPLE WITCHING IS WRONG. This print at 08:30 JST on 2027-03-19 is 19:30 EDT on Thursday 2027-03-18 (US DST begins 2027-03-14). Tokyo's cash session closes 15:00 JST 3/19 = 02:00 EDT, 7.5 hours BEFORE the US triple-witching session opens (opex-2027-03-19, estimate). The two events share a calendar DATE and never a session; the only overlap venue is overnight index futures. The full corridor is FOMC 14:00 EDT 3/17 (fomc-2027-03-17, estimate) -> BoJ ~12:00 JST 3/18 (+9.0h) -> this print (+20.5h) -> US opex open (+14.0h), 43.5 hours end to end. The attribution caution stands and is if anything cleaner than 'same session' implies: anything read out of that stretch still has to be split four ways before any of it is credited to the BoJ. Impact stays LOW, for the same reason its January sibling is: no house playbook is keyed to Japanese CPI, symbols is empty, and this entry's value is corridor structure and calibration rather than a price channel. Two cautions recorded so the next session does not re-derive them: the published schedule ENDS at this row, on a page the Statistics Bureau has not refreshed since 2026-01-23; and the one mechanism that has actually moved a release in this table is a Japanese public holiday falling on the scheduled Friday (2026-03-20, Vernal Equinox Day, which pushed the February-2026 national print to Tuesday 2026-03-24 — 28 of the table's 30 dates are Fridays and both exceptions are that March). Japan's Cabinet Office holiday CSV puts the 2027 equinox on Sunday 2027-03-21 with a substitute holiday Monday 2027-03-22, so 2027-03-19 is holiday-clear — and Tokyo then shuts for three days. Registered as FT-japan-cpi-2027-03-19-2.
